objections: No listed utility task (bike duration, bike zone x hour demand, bike distance, card-type mix) or required field uses the bus fleet number, so keeping it serves no purpose.

The catalog trap is co-traveller narrowing: vehicle + stop + hour band still sharply shrinks the set of people on the same bus as a known colleague (employer + arrival time is in the threat model); merging only vehicles under 5 taps leaves almost all 198 vehicles intact and does not address this.
Suppress removes that linkage at zero utility cost, so the rare-merge keeps more than the purpose needs.
